title: Uniqueness in the Boltzmann–Nordheim Condensate Model
exact_target: Establish uniqueness of the condensate-generating mass-conserving evolution and derive it from more general correlated initial states.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001742 (OWR-4805-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
The Renormalization Group (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/15, pp. 781--824; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 31--32, printed pages 811--812.
Nordheim blow-up and condensation; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The primary equation uses C_3[f_reg], without the superscript (1) present in the curated formula. No separate f_reg^(1) is defined in the report's equation (1). The source's two open questions concern uniqueness once a condensate is generated and extension beyond clustering, rather than merely existence near an equilibrium with a condensate already present.
